findings.summary: MAX_CLUES regression: spec header (line 8) and criterion 4b forbid regressing the previous version's MAX_CLUES=24 profile declaration (⛔ 不得回退). The current profiles/deploy/e0-regression.env declares no MAX_CLUES, agent-harness.env declares none, there is no --max-clues CLI flag, and parseRunCliArgs does not parse one; runChannelWrite falls back to DEFAULT_TICK_CONFIG.maxClues=64 (src/tick.ts:87). With maxClues=64 the board grows far wider than the 2400s wall-clock budget, breaking Z1 self-consistency (criterion 6) — exactly the regression the spec marks forbidden.

§1.1 discriminating test (criterion 2, ⭐⭐) is missing. The only §1.1 test (tick-run.test.ts:1307-1408) asserts timings fields are numbers ≥0 and that totalMs ≥ sum of phases; it does not drive a real --run on a seed board, does not assert the tick runs below node_timeout/2, does not assert termination is readable, and does not go red when the §1.1 fix (phase instrumentation / node_timeout adjustment / exited-early-stop) is reverted. This is the '判别性没落地' rejection pattern the spec calls out at line 179.
